text: BMW M GmbH (Gesellschaft für individuelle Automobile), the BMW M brand owner, is listed among the 'Affiliated companies (subsidiaries) of BMW AG' in BMW AG's Group financial statements with a capital investment of 100%.
short: BMW M GmbH is a 100% subsidiary of BMW AG.

source.name: BMW Group Report 2025 (BMW AG), 'List of investments at 31 December 2025' (p. 351) / 'Disclosures Relevant for Takeovers' (p. 267)
source.note: The same table lists, a few rows down: 'BMW M GmbH Gesellschaft für individuelle Automobile, Munich 3, 5, 6 – – 100' (100% capital investment).
